job.name: ig17_host_3
job.meaning: Пожилой мужчина ~70, белая борода, вязаный свитер, деревянный дом, печь, тёплый свет — «дедушка-мудрец»
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a kind wise Russian old man about 70 with a full neat white beard and white hair, deep kind eyes with laugh lines, a thick undyed wool sweater. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm, warm, knowing expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: an old wooden house interior, a white tiled stove and a warm lamp, softly blurred, warm amber light.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
